in_marathi.name: Sharunikaana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharunikaana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharunikaana is derived from the Sanskrit language and is composed of the words Shara (meaning victory or command) and Nika (meaning new) and Ana (meaning without or free from). The name Sharunikaana signifies the goddess of victory who bestows prosperity and freedom from obstacles. It is also believed to bring fertility and success in endeavors.
